description_en: Modifies the attributes of a network ACL
description_zh: 调用ModifyNetworkAclAttributes接口修改网络ACL的属性
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-network-acl-attributes --network-acl-id acl-bp1lhl0taikrxxxxxxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyNetworkAclAttributes

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network ACL
parameters.name: network_acl_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the network ACL.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
网络ACL的名称。

名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: network_acl_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the network ACL. 

The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
网络ACL的描述信息。 

描述长度为1～256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The region where the network ACL resides.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
网络ACL所在的地域。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run.
false (default): sends the request
parameters.help_zh:
是否检测此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run
